sourceIdentity: The2 actual T96 kernel rows of cost86 are restored through the full original constant-prebasis traces to the original6188 primitive rows. Every original coefficient of A*k is verified divisible by31, and the output is exactly A*k/31 modulo31 from the original integer model modulo961. Each column keeps its own original graph head, source index, raw row, and weighted cost. No infinite or finite cokernel solvability has yet been asserted.
